verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo and a readable headline, but RSVP is shrunk into a tag-sized pill that competes with the badges, the missing-asset placeholder collides with the right-hand time/location text, and the right column is cramped. B is worse: the Tastings, Free Entry, All Ages and RSVP pills overlap each other, the logo is gone, 'Solstice Presents' sits as an orphan under the URL, and the date and details text is too small to read.

A has the same problems: RSVP is demoted to a small pill among the badges, the placeholder overlaps the location text on the right edge, and the small copy is crammed. B drops the logo, pushes 'Solstice Presents' below the URL so the reading order is wrong, sets the date and details in tiny text crowded against the left edge, and loses the CTA among a 2x2 grid of pills with a large dead gap in the middle, so it is slightly worse on brand and hierarchy.
